* Vapor - This villain did not appear in the television series physically for an unknown reason, possibly due to budget issues, but he was referenced in a Wanted poster in a cameo in "The Enemy Within".
NOTE: While Vapor did not physically appear in the series, he only appeared in a Wanted poster in a cameo in Mekron City's police department.
He makes a cameo in The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part.
